Each era left behind the brands still optimising for the last one. Now with AI, we've watched businesses overcome technical bottlenecks, but we've also seen the organisational chaos that followed. Teams build assistants in isolation, prompts are duplicated, knowledge becomes fragmented, and no one knows which tools, outputs, or workflows can be trusted.
